content.text: Every year, thousands of India's most ambitious micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) throw their hats into the ring for the ET MSME Awards. Every year, the list gets longer. And the ceremony gets harder to ignore.This year is no different. Except that it somehow feels bigger.After months of painstaking evaluation, the shortlist for the ET MSME Awards 2025 has been announced. These are the companies that survived the cut not by filling out a form, but by holding up under scrutiny. That’s because our judging process runs for months, involving sector experts and industry veterans who go well beyond any glossy facades to look at real numbers, real impact, and real stories of enterprise.This is what separates the ET MSME Awards from the chaff. In a landscape where business awards have become something of a cottage industry, this one has consistently maintained its standards. It is, without question, India's most credible and most coveted honour for the MSME community, a reflection of what 77.6 million enterprises (and counting) are actually capable of when they put their heads down and get to work.The nominees this year span the full breadth of India's small business economy, from precision auto components to pharmaceutical innovators, from women-led enterprises rewriting the rulebook to exporters flying the Indian flag in global markets.Here is the complete shortlist, category by category.Automobile & OEM MSME of the YearChopra Retec Rubber Products LimitedMinimac Systems Pvt LtdMiba Drivetec India Private LimitedPentagon Forge & Machine LtdSGF Fab IndustriesSun Electro Devices Pvt. LtdElifecycle Management Pvt Ltd (Elima)Spray Engineering Devices LtdThe grand felicitation ceremony takes place on March 24, 2026 in New Delhi. That's when months of effort, evaluation, and anticipation will converge into a single evening, one where conversations and networking will be as valuable as the trophies on the stage. Past editions have drawn policymakers, industry leaders, investors, and entrepreneurs who understand that being in that room isn't just about watching someone else win. It's about being part of the ecosystem that makes winning possible.Miss it, and you'll spend the next week reading about it. Attend, and you'll be part of the story.The nominees have earned their place. The question now is whether you'll be there to witness it.The ET MSME Awards’ grand felicitation ceremony is scheduled for March 24, 2026. For enquiries or more information, visit etmsmeawards.com.
